title: Qaid ki Zanjeer
body:
matam hai aaj momino aise aseer ka
jiske badan ko qaid ki zanjeer kha gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan may ab bhi goonjta hai uska marsiya
jiske badan ko qaid ki zanjeer kha gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan ke andhere may mushkil khushaai ki
karta raha duayein jo apne rehayi ki
lo aaj uske waaste zindan khul gaya
jiske badan ko qaid ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
faryad kar rahi hai wo zinda ki wehshatein
kaise bayan ho sake uski musibatein
bedi ke saath khaal bhi uski hui juda
jiske badan ko qaid ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi to aa ke pusht pe durre laga gaya
koi pyala zehre dagha ka pila gaya
hae hae lahoo lohaan hai jafar ka laadla
jiske badan ko qaid ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
dikhne lagi thi jisme mutahar ki haddiyan
kat kat gayi thi paon ki bedi se pindliyan
marne pe bhi na tauq e giranbar khul saka
jiske badan ko qaid ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran e kirdigaar ke paare hai qaid may
ro ro ke chauda saal guzare hai qaid may
aakhir wo aaj hogaya zindan se reha
jiske badan ko qaid ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
pul par andheri raat ko rakhne ko aaye hai
mazdoor apne kandhon pe laasha uthaye hai
roti hai uske haal pe marqad may fatema
jiske badan ko qaid ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitna ghareeb aaj hamara imam hai
dafn o kafan ka saaman na kuch ehtemam hai
bhai na uske paas bhatija na mehlaqa
jiske badan ko qaid ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
talqeen apne baba ko aa kar padhaiye
maula raza ye laash uthane ko aaiye
pul par rakha hua hai janaza ghareeb ka
jiske badan ko qaid ki...
<<DIVIDER>>
ainee salaam sainkdon aamir ke ho usay
chalta tha qaid khane may jo baith baith ke
rangeen uske khoon se zindan ka farsh tha
jiske badan ko qaid ki...
author: Ainee Rizvi
